senses.definition: To inspect a building or area.
senses.example: We're interested in buying this house. Can we look around tomorrow?
I can't find my keys, so I'll look around.

senses.definition: To turn one's head to see what is behind oneself.
senses.example: He heard a voice and looked around to see a man wearing dark clothes.

senses.definition: To take note of the situation; to make oneself aware.
senses.example: Sure enough, when Jon appeals to centuries-old tradition binding the families of the north together, it comes off as good-hearted but short-sighted. Look around, Jon. It’s a new day. Queens rule the continent. They might rule the North, too, if tradition hadn’t made room for a bastard king. At a certain point, adhering to tradition becomes a failure to adapt. It traps people in the same deepening grooves of history their parents died in.

senses.definition: Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see look, around.
